title: content/needs.yaml — need/value dimension catalog (D9/D10)
description: The need/value Dimension CATALOG: which dimensions exist, their kind, default posture/setpoint/referent, and salience curve. Per-need RATE constants (decay_per_tick, satisfaction_threshold) for consumable needs live in content/balance.yaml's `needs:` block — NOT here (D9: rate only, kept in the single tuning file). engine/needs.Load merges this catalog with the balance rate block. platform/config cross-checks that every consumable dimension here has a balance rate entry and vice-versa.

kind.description: consumable = time-driven (its rate lives in balance.yaml needs:<id>); conditional = event-driven (no rate, absent from the balance needs: block).
